• Benchmark: Based on PaddleOCR PP-OCRv6 offline recognition model architecture
• Text recognition model: PP-OCRv6 offline recognition network for ink image recognition and character candidate extraction
• Inference engine: Custom ONNX Runtime (CPU inference, strictly 16 KB page-aligned)
• Feature extraction: 48px normalized ink image and CTC Top-10 candidate extraction
• Pinyin reverse lookup: Real-time tone mapping based on Unihan and pinyin_dict with rare character support
• Stroke rendering: Cubic Bézier dynamic speed-sensitive ink tip
• Privacy & security: 100% on-device local recognition after model installation, zero ink or text upload
• Memory & battery: On-demand dynamic loading; inference session automatically released after ~60s idle

• On-device model: SenseVoice-Small (Alibaba Tongyi Lab)
• Inference engine: Sherpa-ONNX (v1.13.7) + ONNX Runtime
• Native libraries: 16 KB page-aligned (ELF 16KB compatible)
• Audio format: 16 kHz PCM mono · 80-dim Filter-Bank
• Quantization: INT8 quantized (~239 MB)
• Supported languages: Mandarin · English · Cantonese · Japanese · Korean
• Text features: Built-in ITN text normalization and smart punctuation
• Delivery: Downloaded via HTTPS whitelist only upon user confirmation with SHA-256 verification
• Privacy & security: 100% on-device inference, no audio or recognized text is uploaded

[LIME Keyboard Privacy Policy & Local Inference Commitment]

1. Model Download:
Only upon your explicit confirmation to download offline AI models (voice or handwriting) and dependent shared runtime libraries, the app accesses official or mirror endpoints over HTTPS (Voice: ModelScope, HF-Mirror, Hugging Face; Handwriting & shared runtime: GitHub Releases, ghproxy). Artifacts are verified against fixed versions and SHA-256 hashes within the APK. No remote configuration or cloud recognition is used.

2. Zero Cloud Upload:
Text input, learned vocabulary, handwriting, and voice recognition all execute 100% locally on-device. LIME never uploads keystrokes, passwords, dictionaries, audio, handwriting, or recognized text to any cloud servers.

3. Minimized Permissions:
• Clipboard: Used only for the local quick paste panel, stored solely in the on-device SQLite database;
• Audio Recording (Optional): Used only for on-device Sherpa-ONNX recognition when speech input is actively initiated, never storing audio files;
• Local Storage (Optional): Used only for model storage, user-initiated backups, and custom wallpapers;

4. Open Source & Acknowledgments:
Core input engine librime is licensed under BSD-3-Clause; Sherpa-ONNX is licensed under Apache-2.0, SenseVoice model under FunASR Model License; handwriting engine PaddleOCR PP-OCRv6 under Apache-2.0, inference runtime ONNX Runtime under MIT; Wanxiang dictionary under CC BY 4.0. All voice and handwriting inference runs 100% locally on-device after model download.
